name: The Dead Sea
short_desc: The center of the world drains & rises, crossing is dangerous but going around is slow.
long_desc:
A sea surrounded by continents, on a cycle almost predictable, 3 or 4 weeks at most, it drains. Little life survives within longer than a cycle.
And when it returns, with storm and thunder, it takes from all which surrounds it.
Crossing is dangerous but going around is slow.

name: The Living City
short_desc: An evergrowth born of a Great Tree, an infectious paradise for those within.
long_desc: Mikiltré, the Living City is a paradise to many, growing & changing to house and feed those within. It's spores spreading, changing, and joining them.

name: The ??? Dominion
short_desc: In the Desert rises an oasis of marble and gardens, of euphoria for the privileged.
long_desc: The Dominion has ever been a force upon the sands, where great houses drive daggers held by "indentured servants" into each other. Though they may live long, they do not live cheap.

name: The Lands of Ash
short_desc: The home of devils and demons.
long_desc: Though it's location disputed, any true born devil or demon knows the way. An near inhospitable wasteland split between law and war, devouring itself. No wonder they seek escape.
